tasks.title: free_model_probe.py — free-window health gate CLI
tasks.spec:
Write a standalone Python 3 CLI script (STDLIB ONLY, no third-party imports) named free_model_probe.py that checks whether a model on the Nous inference API is currently free.

Behavior:
- Usage: free_model_probe.py <model_id> [--base-url URL] [--timeout SECONDS]
- Reads the bearer token from the JSON file /opt/data/shared/nous_auth.json, key "access_token".
- GET {base_url}/v1/models (default base_url https://inference-api.nousresearch.com) with an Authorization: Bearer header AND a User-Agent header (the server returns 403 without a User-Agent).
- Find the entry whose id equals the model_id. If absent, print one JSON object {"model": model_id, "present": false, "free": false} and exit 2.
- free means pricing.prompt == 0 AND pricing.completion == 0 (numbers may be int or float or string; coerce with float()).
- Canary check: POST {base_url}/v1/chat/completions with {"model": model_id, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Reply with OK"}], "max_tokens": 5}; canary_ok = HTTP 200.
- Print ONE JSON object to stdout with keys: model, present, free, price_in_per_token, price_out_per_token, canary_ok, checked_at (ISO 8601 UTC string).
- Exit code 0 if present AND free AND canary_ok; exit 1 otherwise. On any internal error print {"error": "..."} and exit 1 — never raise a traceback. HTTP timeouts must be handled.

tasks.title: board_report.py — one-glance worker board status
tasks.spec:
Write a standalone Python 3 CLI script (STDLIB ONLY) named board_report.py that prints a compact status report of the worker board.

Behavior:
- Usage: board_report.py [board_path]  (default /opt/data/missingno-worker/board.json)
- The board JSON has shape {"window": {"status": str, ...}, "tasks": [{"id": str, "title": str, "status": str, "attempts": int, "updated_at": str-or-null}, ...]}.
- Print first line exactly: BOARD: <pending> pending, <done> done, <failed> failed | window: <window.status>
- Then one line per task in file order: <id> | <status> | attempts=<attempts> | <title>
- pending counts tasks with status pending or in_progress.
- Exit 0 on success. If the file is missing or invalid JSON, print one error line to stderr and exit 1. Never raise a traceback.

tasks.title: bench_harness.py — mini coding-benchmark runner with --self-test
tasks.spec:
Write a standalone Python 3 CLI script (STDLIB ONLY) named bench_harness.py that runs a model on small coding prompts and grades the results.

Behavior:
- Usage: bench_harness.py --model <model_id> [--prompts FILE] [--self-test]
- Bearer token from JSON file /opt/data/shared/nous_auth.json key "access_token"; API base https://inference-api.nousresearch.com/v1/chat/completions; always send a User-Agent header.
- Prompts file (default /opt/data/missingno-worker/bench_prompts.json) is a JSON list of {"id": str, "prompt": str, "checks": [{"expr": str}]}. Each prompt asks the model for a small pure Python function; "expr" is a Python expression evaluated with the function's return value bound to the variable "result".
- For each prompt: call the model (max_tokens 1000), extract the last ```python fenced code block (or the whole response if no fence), exec it in a fresh namespace, then call the function under test with the example arguments given in the prompt text, bind the return value to "result", and evaluate each check expr with eval(expr, {"result": result}). A prompt passes if all its checks evaluate truthy and nothing raised.
- If the prompts file does not exist, CREATE it with 3 prompts: add(a, b) returns the sum (check: result == 7 for add(3, 4)); is_palindrome(s) True for 'racecar' (check: result is True); count_vowels(s) counts vowels case-insensitively (check: result == 3 for 'Beautiful'). Each prompt must state the exact function signature and the example call to use.
- --self-test: ignore the prompts file and use one canned prompt: implement add(a, b) returning the sum, call add(3, 4), check result == 7.
- Print ONE JSON object to stdout: {"model": model_id, "results": [{"id": ..., "passed": true/false}], "pass_rate": <float>}. Exit 0 if the harness ran (even with failures), exit 1 only on internal error (bad token, unreadable file, etc.) — never a traceback. Wrap each model call in 3 retries with short sleeps on 429/timeout.
